title: LongLive-Plug: Once-for-All Distillation for Video Generation
title_zh: LongLive-Plug: 一次训练即可供多种下游模型使用的蒸馏框架

paragraphs.en: Abstract: Video diffusion models are increasingly developed into specialized models for diverse downstream tasks, and this development often includes a distillation stage, for example to accelerate sampling or to improve long-video generation. This stage is typically repeated for every specialized model. We introduce LongLive-Plug, a once-for-all distillation framework that learns reusable capabilities as LoRAs on a base model for training-free, plug-and-play deployment to compatible downstream models. These capabilities include single-pass classifier-free guidance, few-step sampling, and long-context error correction for autoregressive generation. The adapters remain reusable even when downstream models add conditioning branches, expand output channels. Despite training at a fixed guidance scale, our dedicated CFG LoRA provides text guidance control through its inference weight. Combining it with a few-step LoRA simultaneously preserves few-step generation and CFG controllability on downstream tasks. We verify training-free deployment on 54 downstream models across three backbone families and eight task categories, including world modeling, robotics, editing, and multimodal generation. The approach may support additional compatible models. Each capability can thus be distilled once per backbone family and reused without per-target retraining.
paragraphs.zh: 摘要：视频扩散模型正日益被开发为适用于各种下游任务的专用模型，这一开发过程通常包含一个蒸馏阶段，例如用于加速采样或提升长视频生成效果。 该阶段通常需要在每个专用模型中重复执行。 我们提出 LongLive-Plug——一种一次性蒸馏框架，它能在基础模型上学习可复用的能力并以 LoRA 形式存储，从而实现无需训练、即插即用的部署，适用于兼容的下游模型。 这些能力包括单遍无分类器引导、少步采样以及用于自回归生成的长上下文错误校正。 即使下游模型增加了条件分支或扩展了输出通道，这些适配器仍然可以重复使用。 尽管训练时使用了固定的引导尺度，但我们专门的 CFG LoRA 仍可通过其推理权重提供文本引导控制。 将其与少步 LoRA 结合使用，可在下游任务中同时保留少步生成能力和 CFG 可控性。 我们在三种主干模型家族和八类任务（包括世界建模、机器人技术、编辑和多模态生成）的 54 个下游模型上验证了无需训练的部署效果。 该方法可能还支持其他兼容模型。 因此，每种能力只需在每个主干模型家族中蒸馏一次，即可重复使用，而无需针对每个目标模型重新训练。

paragraphs.en: Large-scale video diffusion transformers form reusable foundations for video generation [ 89 , 41 , 69 ] , while downstream applications increasingly depend on specialized models. They can be adapted to diverse tasks, including controllable generation and personalization [ 73 , 81 ] , video editing [ 59 ] , and action-conditioned world simulation for robotics and physical AI [ 60 , 56 ] . Developing such a specialized model often includes a distillation stage, for example to accelerate sampling or to improve long-video generation, and this stage is typically repeated for every new model, each requiring data preparation, teacher supervision, and optimization. This repeated cost motivates a once-for-all workflow: distill reusable capabilities once on a base model and deploy them across compatible downstream models.

paragraphs.en: We introduce LongLive-Plug, a once-for-all distillation framework built on reusable functional LoRAs [ 31 ] . Each adapter is learned on a base model and attached to compatible downstream models while retaining their task-specific weights ( ). We consider three capabilities: classifier-free guidance (CFG) distillation combines two-pass guidance into one model evaluation [ 52 , 57 ] while retaining continuous control over guidance strength; few-step distillation enables four-step sampling [ 91 ] ; and long-context distillation improves long-video quality through error correction in models that support causal autoregressive (AR) inference. Once trained on the base model, these adapters support training-free, plug-and-play deployment to compatible downstream models, even when those models add conditioning branches, or expand output channels.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 LongLive-Plug，这是一个基于可复用功能 LoRA [31] 的一次性蒸馏框架。 每个适配器都在基础模型上进行学习，并附加到兼容的下游模型中，同时保留这些模型的任务特定权重（）。 我们考虑了三种能力：无分类器引导（CFG）蒸馏将两遍引导整合到单次模型评估中 [52, 57]，同时保持对引导强度的连续控制；少步蒸馏实现了四步采样 [91]；而长上下文蒸馏则通过在支持因果自回归（AR）推理的模型中进行错误校正，提升了长视频的质量。 一旦在基础模型上完成训练，这些适配器即可支持无需重新训练的即插即用部署，适用于兼容的下游模型，即使这些模型增加了条件分支或扩展了输出通道。

paragraphs.en: Making these functional LoRAs transferable raises two further questions. The first concerns guidance. Existing few-step distillation methods, such as CausVid and Self Forcing [ 93 , 33 ] , distill CFG and few-step generation jointly, which fixes guidance at the scale used during training. Downstream tasks, however, often favor different guidance strengths, so a single fixed scale cannot serve all of them. We therefore apply decoupled distillation, which distills CFG and few-step generation into separate LoRAs. The inference weight of the CFG LoRA then acts as a guidance dial: scaling it adjusts guidance strength in a near-linear manner, as we observe empirically and as prior work on scaling fine-tuning updates suggests [ 82 , 35 ] . Adjusting this weight while keeping the few-step LoRA fixed tailors guidance to each downstream task. By contrast, rescaling a jointly distilled LoRA also perturbs few-step generation and can cause collapse.
paragraphs.zh: 使这些功能性 LoRA 具备可迁移性，会引发另外两个问题。 第一个问题涉及引导机制。 现有的少步蒸馏方法（如 CausVid 和 Self Forcing [93, 33]）会将 CFG 和少步生成联合蒸馏，从而将引导机制固定为训练时使用的强度。 然而，下游任务通常需要不同的引导强度，因此单一固定的强度无法满足所有任务的需求。 因此，我们采用解耦蒸馏方法，将 CFG 和少步生成分别蒸馏到独立的 LoRA 中。 此时，CFG LoRA 的推理权重就充当了引导调节器：调整该权重可以近乎线性地改变引导强度，这一结论既得到了我们的实证观察支持，也与先前关于缩放微调更新的研究一致 [82, 35]。 在保持少步 LoRA 不变的情况下调整该权重，即可为每个下游任务定制合适的引导机制。 相比之下，重新缩放联合蒸馏的 LoRA 也会干扰少步生成，甚至可能导致模型崩溃。

paragraphs.en: The second question is how the training of a functional LoRA affects its transfer. We report two empirical findings. Adapter rank matters: a small adapter may fit the base teacher well yet transfer poorly, so source fit alone does not determine the capacity needed for transfer. The distillation data also matters: broad T2V prompts on the base model expose the adapter to diverse generation behavior, and broader prompt coverage improves transfer. Together, these findings indicate how to learn acceleration that remains useful beyond the checkpoint on which it was distilled.
paragraphs.zh: 第二个问题是，功能性 LoRA 的训练如何影响其迁移效果。 我们报告了两项经验性发现。 适配器秩至关重要：一个小型适配器可能很好地拟合基础教师模型，但迁移效果却很差，因此仅凭源模型的拟合程度无法决定迁移所需的能力。 蒸馏数据同样重要：在基础模型上使用广泛的 T2V 提示，能让适配器接触到多样化的生成行为，而更全面的提示覆盖范围能提升迁移效果。 综合来看，这些发现揭示了如何学习一种在蒸馏所用检查点之外仍然有用的加速方法。

paragraphs.en: The functional-LoRA formulation also extends to error correction for long contexts. We learn this capability through long-context distillation . Using Streaming Long Tuning [ 86 ] , we optimize a LoRA on a causal AR version of the base model using distribution matching distillation (DMD). The model extends its own generated history, while a teacher supervises each newly generated short clip. This exposes the adapter to errors accumulated during extended rollouts and teaches it to sustain long-video quality. The resulting functional LoRA makes long-context error correction reusable across compatible downstream models that support causal AR inference.
paragraphs.zh: 功能-LoRA 的公式也适用于长上下文的错误校正。 我们通过长上下文蒸馏来学习这种能力。 利用流式长调优 [86]，我们使用分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）在基础模型的因果自回归版本上优化一个 LoRA。 该模型会扩展自身生成的历史，同时由一个教师模型监督每个新生成的短片段。 这使得适配器能够接触到在长时间推理过程中累积的错误，并学会维持长视频的质量。 由此产生的功能 LoRA 使得长上下文错误校正可以在支持因果自回归推理的兼容下游模型中重复使用。

paragraphs.en: We verify training-free deployment on 54 downstream models from three backbone families: Wan2.1-14B, Wan2.2-TI2V-5B, and MiniMax-H3. They span eight task categories, including world modeling, robotics, controllable generation, editing, and multimodal generation. The verified coverage is listed in Tab. 5 in Appendix C ; our approach may support additional compatible models. Quantitative comparisons on SCOPE and Wan2.2-Fun-5B-Control show improvements over naive four-step sampling and performance competitive with per-target distillation, without additional downstream training. Further experiments show that independent CFG control helps transfer to tasks with different guidance preferences, and that larger adapter ranks and broader distillation data can improve transfer quality. Separately, transferring the long-context LoRA to the ReWorld [ 15 ] and Matrix-Game 3.0 [ 80 ] world models improves video quality during long autoregressive rollouts. These results demonstrate reusable acceleration and long-context error correction across downstream models.

sents.en: Further experiments show that independent CFG control helps transfer to tasks with different guidance preferences, and that larger adapter ranks and broader distillation data can improve transfer quality.
sents.zh: 进一步实验表明，独立的 CFG 控制有助于将模型迁移到具有不同引导偏好的任务中，而更大的适配器秩和更广泛的蒸馏数据可以提升迁移质量。

sents.en: Separately, transferring the long-context LoRA to the ReWorld [ 15 ] and Matrix-Game 3.0 [ 80 ] world models improves video quality during long autoregressive rollouts.

sents.en: These results demonstrate reusable acceleration and long-context error correction across downstream models.

paragraphs.en: Progressive distillation shortens sampling trajectories [ 62 ] , and distribution matching enables one-step generation [ 92 ] . VideoLCM uses consistency distillation [ 74 ] , T2V-Turbo adds reward feedback [ 44 ] , and DOLLAR combines score and consistency objectives [ 22 ] . LCM-LoRA packages consistency distillation for reuse across Stable Diffusion fine-tunes [ 51 ] . Guidance distillation merges the two CFG branches into one pass [ 52 ] , while adapter guidance distillation reduces trainable parameters and examines transfer to image-model derivatives [ 57 ] . CausVid converts bidirectional teachers into autoregressive generators with KV caching [ 93 ] ; Self Forcing uses autoregressive training rollouts to reduce the train–test mismatch [ 33 ] . We isolate distilled capabilities in reusable LoRAs for compatible video specializations: CFG and few-step distillation accelerate inference, while long-context distillation corrects errors in models that already support AR inference. Plug-and-Play Diffusion Distillation transfers a non-LoRA guide network across fine-tuned image models [ 30 ] . CASA transfers downstream LoRAs to few-step video models [ 76 ] , whereas we transfer distilled capability LoRAs to a broader range of downstream tasks and model variants.
paragraphs.zh: 渐进式蒸馏缩短了采样轨迹 [ 62 ]，而分布匹配则实现了一步生成 [ 92 ]。 VideoLCM 使用了一致性蒸馏 [ 74 ]，T2V-Turbo 增加了奖励反馈 [ 44 ]，而 DOLLAR 结合了分数目标和一致性目标 [ 22 ]。 LCM-LoRA 将一致性蒸馏封装起来，以便在多个 Stable Diffusion 微调版本中重复使用 [ 51 ]。 引导蒸馏将两个 CFG 分支合并为一次处理流程 [ 52 ]，而适配器引导蒸馏则减少了可训练参数，并检验了向图像模型衍生模型的迁移效果 [ 57 ]。 CausVid 通过 KV 缓存将双向教师模型转换为自回归生成器 [ 93]；Self Forcing 利用自回归训练展开来减少训练与测试之间的不匹配 [ 33]。 我们将蒸馏后的能力隔离在可重复使用的 LoRA 中，以适配不同的视频专用任务：CFG 和少步蒸馏能够加速推理，而长上下文蒸馏则能修正那些已支持 AR 推理的模型中的错误。 即插即用扩散蒸馏可将非 LoRA 的引导网络迁移到多个微调后的图像模型中 [ 30]。 CASA 将下游 LoRA 迁移到少步视频模型中 [ 76]，而我们将蒸馏能力 LoRA 迁移到了更广泛的下游任务和模型变体中。

paragraphs.en: We distill CFG and few-step adapters on the base model using broad T2V prompts covering diverse subjects, scenes, motions, and styles. This exposes the adapters to varied generation behavior without target training data. Section 4.4 tests how prompt diversity affects transfer.

paragraphs.en: To correct errors accumulated during AR rollouts, we train ϕ long \phi_{\mathrm{long}} on a frozen causal AR base model using Streaming Long Tuning [ 86 ] . The student generates each short clip from its cached history, while a pretrained teacher provides distribution matching distillation (DMD) supervision. Detaching the preceding history keeps gradients local to the current clip as training rollouts grow longer. The resulting LoRA transfers to compatible models without target-specific training and improves their long-context generation quality. It can be applied to models with existing causal attention.
paragraphs.zh: 为了纠正在 AR 展开过程中累积的错误，我们使用 Streaming Long Tuning [86] 在冻结的因果 AR 基础模型上训练 ϕ long \phi_{\mathrm{long}}。 学生模型根据缓存的历史生成每个短片段，同时预训练的教师模型提供分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）监督。 通过分离前面的历史，随着训练展开的长度增加，梯度会保持在当前片段内部。 由此产生的 LoRA 无需针对特定目标进行训练即可迁移到兼容模型，并提升其长上下文生成质量。 该方法可以应用于已有因果注意力的模型。

Native inference uses 30 steps for SCOPE and 40 for ControlNet; directly reducing it to four steps is faster but substantially degrades generation quality. Per-target DMD2 distillation [ 91 ] recovers good four-step quality, but adds substantial per-task data collection, training, and tuning costs. Our CFG-only and few-step LoRAs are trained on the base model with the broad T2V data in Sec. 3.3 ; the few-step adapter uses DMD2 with CFG-guided teacher supervision. Combining these adapters enables plug-and-play transfer with zero downstream training cost , requiring no target data or fine-tuning. paragraphs.en: We verify training-free deployment across three backbone families: Wan2.1-14B, Wan2.2-TI2V-5B [ 69 ] , and MiniMax-H3 [ 53 ] . Table 5 in Appendix C lists the 54 verified downstream models: 24 for each Wan backbone and six for H3. They span eight task categories: world modeling, robotics, structure-conditioned generation, camera and trajectory control, video editing and restoration, subject and avatar generation, audio and RGBA generation, and domain, style, and quality adaptation. Each family reuses adapters distilled on its own base model without downstream training, extending capability reuse to full fine-tunes, task LoRAs, and models with additional conditioning modules. We compare native inference with four-step, CFG-free inference after attaching the base-distilled LoRA. For models with 20–50-step native schedules, this reduces denoising steps by 5 5 – 12.5 × 12.5\times . The approach may support additional compatible downstream models beyond this verified set.

paragraphs.en: We vary prompt diversity with the teacher, rank, target layers, optimization budget, and number of training lines fixed. Prompt concentration is the mean pairwise cosine similarity in centred UMT5 [ 18 ] embedding space: lower values indicate broader coverage, while higher values indicate prompts clustered in one region. paragraphs.en: We presented LongLive-Plug, which distills CFG, few-step sampling, and long-context error correction into reusable LoRAs once per backbone family. These adapters enable training-free transfer to compatible downstream models with adjustable guidance. Experiments demonstrate effective acceleration and improved long-video quality across tasks, reducing the need for per-target distillation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 LongLive-Plug，它将 CFG、少步采样和长上下文纠错技术蒸馏为可重用的 LoRAs，每个骨干模型族只需蒸馏一次。 这些适配器支持无需训练的迁移到兼容的下游模型，并具备可调的引导能力。 实验表明，该方法在不同任务中有效提升了速度并改善了长视频质量，减少了对每个目标模型单独蒸馏的需求。
